cards.title: Massively parallel digital transcriptional profiling of single cells.
cards.identity: Guide/existing-owner identifier resolved through Europe PMC; Zheng also agrees in Crossref.
cards.readingScope: Droplet 3-prime RNA counting and defined research demonstrations; no universal capture or clinical-performance number adopted.

cards.title: Guidelines for the use and interpretation of assays for monitoring autophagy (4th edition)<sup>1</sup>.
cards.identity: Guide/existing-owner identifier resolved through Europe PMC; Zheng also agrees in Crossref.
cards.sourceType: Autophagy assay interpretation consensus guidelines, fourth edition (2021)
cards.readingScope: Assay choice depends on question/system; multiple techniques and distinct autophagy-gene perturbations are recommended. The fresh abstract is not used as a substitute for unread flux-method sections.

officialScope: NCI matched-treatment uncertainty and specimen/evidence context; NHGRI RNA/transcription concepts. The historical liquid-biopsy approval count, exact gene census, broad assay-completeness language and unrelated clinical examples are not adopted as current inventories. Reading a complete block does not independently verify every unrelated claim in it.

inheritedSourceCards.title: Aberrant luminal progenitors as the candidate target population for basal tumor development in BRCA1 mutation carriers.
inheritedSourceCards.abstractReadingNote: BRCA1-carrier tissue and basal tumour expression resemble luminal progenitors; candidate transformation population, not ancestry or a diagnosis from one marker.

inheritedSourceCards.title: Ischemia in tumors induces early and sustained phosphorylation changes in stress kinase pathways but does not affect global protein levels.
inheritedSourceCards.abstractReadingNote: Ovarian tumour/breast xenograft ischemia experiment, up to 24% phosphoproteome changed while global protein mostly unchanged at 60 min; preanalytical stress can affect phospho-readouts.

inheritedSourceCards.title: Single-cell RNA-seq highlights intratumoral heterogeneity in primary glioblastoma.
inheritedSourceCards.abstractReadingNote: 430 cells from five glioblastomas, heterogeneous programs and classifier states. RNA-derived copy-number method needs body; breast/general ancestry extrapolation not empirical result.

inheritedSourceCards.title: Guidelines for Validation of Next-Generation Sequencing-Based Oncology Panels: A Joint Consensus Recommendation of the Association for Molecular Pathology and College of American Pathologists.
inheritedSourceCards.sourceType: Joint professional NGS validation consensus guidance (2017)

inheritedSourceCards.title: A single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-Seq toolbox for fresh and frozen human tumors.
inheritedSourceCards.abstractReadingNote: 40 samples, 23 specimens, eight tumour types; matched scRNA/snRNA recover same cell types in different proportions. Recovery QC and tissue-specific methods matter.
inheritedSourceCards.sourceType: Primary tumour cell/nucleus preparation and recovery study

inheritedSourceCards.title: SoupX removes ambient RNA contamination from droplet-based single-cell RNA sequencing data.
inheritedSourceCards.abstractReadingNote: Ambient cell-free RNA contaminates droplets; SoupX estimates correction. Cell-associated expression and identity still require assay/QC context, not infallible cleaning.

inheritedSourceCards.title: Confronting false discoveries in single-cell differential expression.
inheritedSourceCards.abstractReadingNote: Differential expression must account for biological replicate variation; many cells from one biopsy do not create independent patient replication.

inheritedBoundary: Existing owner examples and assay/guideline evidence retain the prior recorded abstracts or targeted-passage depths. This followup compares exact current fields; it is not fresh independent verification of all owner assertions.
